keyboardReports.bridgePath: usb_event_callback and ble_raw_serial_callback enqueue EVENT_TYPE_RELAY; app_handle_relay forwards to bt_serial_tx or furi_hal_hid_vendor_send_response only. No keyboard report function appears in relay callbacks or app_handle_relay.
keyboardReports.deployGate: app_start_typing is called only from app_handle_input while screen is AirbridgeScreenDeployPrompt on OK; 0x42 starts streaming only from AirbridgeScreenWaiting and remains relay data in AirbridgeScreenBridge.

typingJitter.seed: furi_get_tick XOR bootstrap length XOR typing_generation
typingJitter.abortSemantics: app_service_input runs before app_typing_step every loop and at BLE retry boundaries; BACK still calls app_abort_typing and returns to Bridge without waiting for typing completion.

bleAdvertisingUuid.reason: Firmware currently advertises the AirBridge serial service UUID via GapConfig. Removing it requires changing Web Bluetooth from service filtering to acceptAllDevices plus optionalServices and then physically proving picker UX, wrong-device safe failure, pairing, and reconnect on Chromium. Hardware is absent in this session, so UUID hiding is deferred rather than guessed.
bleAdvertisingUuid.mdnConstraint: With acceptAllDevices:true filters must be omitted and optionalServices must include the service to access it after selection.

disSerial.configOverride: ble_dis_serial in /ext/apps_data/pocket_airbridge/config still overrides the derived default.
